title: ProvenanceManifest
description: Repository-tracked declaration of on-chain project identity and expected artifact extras for git-provenance-anchor verification.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest format version. Currently only 1 is accepted.

label.description: Human-readable project label stored on registration. Not used for authorisation.

networks.description: Deployment network keys under deployments/ to query during verify (default: all known testnets).

extras.description: Paths expected in release artifacts but absent from the anchored Git tree.

path.description: Relative path or glob (forward slashes) of an expected extra file or directory tree.

reason.description: Why this path is allowed to appear outside the anchored tree.

source.description: What generates the path (tool, script, or process).
